scope: Saved-view client contract and UI with every API fulfilled locally. CRUD writes modify only this script memory.

contracts.reads: Directory is on demand; scoped pagination is not a full-result claim.
contracts.save: Only committed query and applied table state; fixed editor snapshots, stable create ID, CAS revisions and no automatic write retries.
contracts.load: A confirmed resource snapshot is copied into literal URL/table state, not dynamically bound by saved-view ID.
contracts.unknown: GET reads current resource state, not an exact receipt for the original mutation. No durable unknown-operation journal is claimed.
contracts.browser: Chrome desktop/mobile viewports, synthetic composition and local fixtures are not real-provider, physical-device, Safari or final visual acceptance.

checks.name: A URL change before the first React navigation subscription initializes the actual project and query
Mount does not read the saved-view directory and opening it reads one scoped page
Load more keeps the denominator and does not claim the first window is the whole result set
Dirty Basic candidates disable saving with a reason and do not issue writes
Create saves only committed query and applied table state without changing the URL
Loading a view copies its snapshot to query and table state with one canonical transition
Refreshing keeps literal query state without silently binding to a newer resource revision
Loading against a dirty query requires an explicit Keep or Load decision
Dirty JQL is not saved or silently replaced

failures.check: Local validation and dirty-close protection preserve name and do not submit empty names
